newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador public foreign debt down to $12.48 bln.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador public foreign debt down to $12.48 bln.

text.p: Ecuador's public foreign debt fell $18 million in September to $12.48 billion, a Central Bank report said Thursday.
The public foreign debt in September 1995 was $12.37 billion.
Private foreign debt stood at $2.11 billion in September 1996.
Total foreign debt rose to $14.6 billion in September 1996, up from $13.81 billion in 1995.
Ecuador's government said that in 1997 they will seek to renegotiate about $2 billion in Paris Club debt.
